notes.title: Folian 0.1.0 beta 6
items: Adds a native `Folian > Check for Updates...` menu item for packaged desktop builds.
Uses the existing signed desktop update feed without changing the updater architecture.
Shows clear update check states for checking, up to date, update available, update ready and connection failures.
Groups AI model choices into Recommended, Advanced models and Older supported models.
Keeps only the clearest everyday writing models marked as recommended while preserving advanced model flexibility.

Preserves all beta 5 release engineering improvements, including config.folian.app update discovery, remote model catalogue refresh, local writing data separation, exports, backups and encrypted API key storage.

notes.title: Folian paid beta release candidate
items: Uses config.folian.app for desktop update discovery and the remote AI model catalogue.
Adds verified current and older supported AI model choices.
Keeps the stable desktop channel inactive until a real stable release is promoted.
Protects partial project setting updates from clearing omitted fields.
Preserves local projects, encrypted API keys, exports and backups during application updates.

notes.title: Folian beta foundation
items: Structured project setup, manuscript editing, research and export workflows.
